about: The mutant ledger of internal/sketch/std: edits of the std sources (the .ergo declarations and the Go that reads them) that some test, law or example must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./internal/sketch/std; docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger", says when a change must run it and how to add a mutant. Seeded by ESC1 (wf10, lang audit B F1).

mutants.name: esc1-timeout-nonescaping
mutants.from: f escaping func() A fails E needs R
mutants.to: f func() A fails E needs R
mutants.rule: A joined child task is not the caller's task: a timeout callback cannot borrow a caller-owned Set.

mutants.name: esc1-transform-nonescaping
mutants.rule: types.md, Function values 2: a callback that runs on other tasks at the same time is escaping, so the capture rule refuses a write to the caller's let mut (lang audit B F1, probe race).

mutants.name: esc1-feed-nonescaping
mutants.from: run escaping func(send func(e E))) fails Stopped
mutants.to: run func(send func(e E))) fails Stopped
mutants.rule: std.ArgClauses: a Go body's parameter clause matches its review; ActorFeed runs run on a task of its own after feed returned.

mutants.name: strengths-bench-dir-undeclared
mutants.rule: The strengths table's benchmark reads stay in the declared closure: a Lowering cell that names a benchmark outside benchmarkPackages is refused by the test, not found later by the closure sweep.

mutants.name: ss1-host-elapsed-mono
mutants.rule: stdlib.md time, Clock.ElapsedIsNowSub: the host's Elapsed of a time with a monotonic reading is the monotonic read less t's.
mutants.gap: Only a lowered program runs it, so the std ledger judges it uncovered (docs/tooling.md, Mutant ledger); its killer is run by hand: red at std-speed-1, 2026-11-13.

mutants.name: ss1-host-elapsed-wall
mutants.rule: stdlib.md time, Clock.ElapsedIsNowSub: the host's Elapsed of a time with no monotonic reading is Now().Sub(t) by the wall.
mutants.gap: Only a lowered program runs it, so the std ledger judges it uncovered (docs/tooling.md, Mutant ledger); its killer is run by hand: red at std-speed-1, 2026-11-13.

mutants.name: ss1-input-lines-feed
mutants.rule: stdlib.md io: Input's Lines splits at each line feed.
mutants.gap: Only a lowered program runs it, so the std ledger judges it uncovered (docs/tooling.md, Mutant ledger); its killer is run by hand: red at std-speed-1, 2026-11-13.

mutants.name: stdsh-trimleft-binding
mutants.rule: stdlib.md strings 10: TrimLeft binds Go's TrimLeft (law TrimLeftRightKeepEnds).

mutants.name: stdsh-builder-write
mutants.rule: stdlib.md strings 10: a Builder's text is its writes in order (law BuilderConcatenates).

mutants.name: stdsh-max-binding
mutants.rule: stdlib.md cmp: Max is the larger value (law MaxMinSplit).

mutants.name: sb2-writefrom-start
mutants.rule: stdlib.md strings 11: WriteFrom copies from start (law WriteFromRepeats).

mutants.name: sb2-frombytes-drops
mutants.rule: stdlib.md strings 11: FromBytes is the text of its bytes (law BytesRoundTrip).

mutants.name: sb4-sorted-copies
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Slices and Maps 1: Sorted sorts the slice it collects in place, with no copy.

mutants.name: sj0-chunk-size-short
mutants.rule: stdlib.md io 10: Chunked's chunks are size bytes, the last one shorter (ChunksJoinToInput).

mutants.name: sj0-cut-not-passed
mutants.rule: stdlib.md io 10: a chunk is not empty; each kept cut ends one chunk (ChunksJoinToInput).

mutants.name: sj0-empty-last-chunk
mutants.rule: stdlib.md io 10: Read gives None at the end, never an empty chunk, and None again after it (ChunksJoinToInput).

mutants.name: sj0-cut-kept-twice
mutants.rule: stdlib.md io 10: CutAt keeps a cut only when it is after the one before (ChunksJoinToInput: no empty chunk).

mutants.name: sj0-stdin-ends-early
mutants.from: if chunk == "" { None } else { Some[string]{Value: chunk} }
mutants.to: if len(chunk) < 4096 { None } else { Some[string]{Value: chunk} }
mutants.rule: stdlib.md io 10: In's Read gives None only at the end of standard input.

mutants.name: sj1-refill-drops-rest
mutants.rule: stdlib.md json Stream: a token cut by a chunk edge reads whole (StreamRoundTrips).

mutants.name: sj1-depth-off-by-one
mutants.rule: stdlib.md json Stream: Open's nesting limit (StreamAgreesOnPieces).

mutants.name: sj1-offset-in-chunk
mutants.rule: stdlib.md json Stream: a break's offset is in the whole text, as Open's (StreamAgreesWithDecode).

mutants.name: sj1-maxbytes-not-first
mutants.rule: stdlib.md json Stream: MaxBytes is checked before every other rule, as Open checks it (StreamAgreesOnPieces).

mutants.name: sj1-tag-first-only
mutants.rule: stdlib.md json Stream: Tag finds "_tag" wherever it stands (StreamFindsTagAnywhere).

mutants.name: sj1-failure-not-settled
mutants.rule: stdlib.md json Stream: DecodeStream fails Malformed, not a shape failure, on a text that is not JSON (StreamAgreesOnPieces).

mutants.name: sj1-pair-not-joined
mutants.rule: stdlib.md json Stream: a surrogate pair reads as its rune, as Cursor reads it (StreamAgreesOnPieces).

mutants.name: sj1-list-index
mutants.rule: stdlib.md json Stream: a shape failure's path names the list index, as Cursor's (StreamAgreesOnPieces).

mutants.name: sj2-element-break-untold
mutants.rule: stdlib.md json 8: an element Next gives was read from text that keeps Open's rules up to its end (ValuesStopAtBreak).

mutants.name: sj2-element-failure-unsettled
mutants.rule: stdlib.md json 8: an element's shape failure settles the text first, so a break is told before it (ElementsAgreeOnPieces).

mutants.name: sj2-end-unsettled
mutants.rule: stdlib.md json 8: None comes only once the rest of the text is settled (ElementsEqualWholeDecode).

mutants.name: sj2-sequence-one-value
mutants.from: if s.seq && s.nc == 0 && (s.state == sRoot || s.state == sValue) {
mutants.to: if false && s.seq && s.nc == 0 && (s.state == sRoot || s.state == sValue) {
mutants.rule: stdlib.md json 8: a sequence stream reads value after value (ValuesRoundTrip).

mutants.name: sj2-window-keeps-text
mutants.from: let keep = if s.mark >= 0 { s.mark } else { s.i }
mutants.rule: stdlib.md json 8: the Stream keeps one window, not the text (ElementsHoldOneWindow, the growth guard).

mutants.name: sj2s-read-marks-shared
mutants.rule: stdlib.md json 8: no Reader operation or Elements step reads the state with Get, which marks it shared, so the next operation copies it (TestEventsStreamCounts).

mutants.name: sj2s-queue-regrows
mutants.rule: stdlib.md json 8: the token queue keeps its room when emptied, so a token costs no allocation (TestEventsStreamCounts).

mutants.name: sj2s-number-built
mutants.rule: stdlib.md json 8: a number's spelling is a slice of the window, not a copy (TestEventsStreamCounts).

mutants.name: sj2s-string-built
mutants.from:
// No escape: the text is a slice of the window.
		let text = s.buf[s.mark:s.i]
mutants.to:
// No escape: the text is a slice of the window.
		let text = own(s.buf[s.mark:s.i])
mutants.rule: stdlib.md json 8: a string with no escape is a slice of the window, not a copy (TestEventsStreamCounts).

mutants.name: sj2s-value-not-owned
mutants.from: if s.wrong { "" } else if t.raw { own(t.text) } else { t.text }
mutants.to: if s.wrong { "" } else if t.raw { t.text } else { t.text }
mutants.rule: stdlib.md json 8: a string value the Stream gives the caller is copied, so a kept value does not keep its window (TestStreamValuesKeepNoWindow).

mutants.name: sj2s-rare-inline
mutants.rule: stdlib.md json 8: the state a token never touches sits behind its own Ref, so each Reader operation copies only scan (TestEventsStreamCounts; measured 1.98 of the control without the split).

mutants.name: span-cut-ignores-start
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Text spans 2: Cut is the bytes from Start up to End (laws FieldsAreGoFields, ModelAgrees).

mutants.name: span-spans-built-with-other-text
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Text spans 3: Collect gives None when a span is not In its own text, so a Spans never holds a span of another text (law CollectChecksEverySpan).

mutants.name: span-sub-ignores-width
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Text spans 2: Sub is None when its offsets leave the span (law SubThenCutIsCutThenSlice).

mutants.name: span-find-relative-offset
mutants.from: Span{Start: sp.Start + i, End: sp.Start + i + len(sub)}
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Text spans 2: Find's span is in the text's offsets, not the piece's (law FindIsTheFirstInside).

mutants.name: span-fields-drops-last
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Text spans 2: Fields gives every run, the last one with no space after it included (law FieldsAreGoFields).

mutants.name: span-equal-unchecked
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Text spans 2: Equal is false for a span outside the text, never a defect (law EqualAgreesWithCut).

mutants.name: span-get-unchecked
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Text spans 2: Get is the checked read, None outside the text (law GetIsCut).

mutants.name: span-binds-the-runtime
mutants.from: func Cut(s string, sp Span) string { strings.Slice(s, sp.Start, sp.End) }
mutants.to:
extern go ergo.local/prototype/runtime/v1.StringsSlice func slice(s string, i int, j int) string

func Cut(s string, sp Span) string { slice(s, sp.Start, sp.End) }
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Text spans 5 (STD-NOPRIV): text binds no runtime body, so a module can copy it; the laws stay green under this edit, only the copy check sees it.

mutants.name: bn1-ties-untied
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 3: tied sizes share their mid-rank (law MatchesEnumeration).

mutants.name: bn1-zeros-kept
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 3: the signed-rank test drops zero differences (law MatchesEnumeration).

mutants.name: bn1-walsh-index
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 4: the interval is [W(c), W(m-1-c)] (laws IntervalCoverageIsExact, Mirror).

mutants.name: bn1-look-95
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 5: a planned look judges at Pocock's 98.42% (law PlannedLevelIsPocock).

mutants.name: bn1-holm-unsorted
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 9: Holm steps down over the p-values in ascending order (law HolmRejectsNoMore).

mutants.name: bn1-bound-on-ratio
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, A symmetric bound: the bound is symmetric in log space, so swapping the sides mirrors the verdict (law Mirror).

mutants.name: bn1-five-pairs
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 6: fewer than 6 pairs never decide (law FewPairsNeverDecide).

mutants.name: bn1-exact-moved
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 8: an exact counter that moves is refused CounterUnstable (law ExactIsExact).

mutants.name: bn1-bound-absolute
mutants.from: f * if b >= h { b } else { h }
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 7: on the difference scale the bound is b times the larger median, so no verdict depends on the unit (law ScaleFree).

mutants.name: bn1-zero-interval-unclear
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 7: a change claim whose interval is exactly [0, 0] is Same (law AllEqualIsSame).

mutants.name: bn1-center-midrange
mutants.from: let center = if m%2 == 1 { w[m/2] } else { (w[m/2-1] + w[m/2]) / 2.0 }
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 4: the estimate is the median of the Walsh averages (law IntervalHoldsEstimate).

mutants.name: bn1-coverage-half
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 4: the interval covers 1 - 2 P(T <= c) (law IntervalCoverageIsExact).

mutants.name: bn1-noworse-reads-center
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 7: NoWorse needs the whole interval below the margin (law NoWorseReadsTheInterval).

mutants.name: bn1-holm-uncorrected
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 9: Holm divides alpha by the p-values left (law HolmRejectsNoMore).

mutants.name: bn2-base-first-always
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 2: pairs run base first and head first in turn (law AlternatesOrder).

mutants.name: bn2-look-each-pair
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 5: a series is judged only at the design's looks (law MatchesReference).

mutants.name: bn2-warmup-kept
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 2: one warm block of each side is discarded (law MatchesReference).

mutants.name: bn2-refusal-as-zero
mutants.from:
case (Lost as l, _):
			words[i] = Some[Verdict]{Value: Refused{Why: l.Why}}
mutants.to:
case (Lost as l, _):
			pairs[i] = pairs[i].Append(Pair{Base: 0.0, Head: if l.Why == NoMetric { 0.0 } else { 0.0 }})
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Verdicts and refusals: a refusal carries no number and is never read as 0 (law MatchesReference).

mutants.from: if words[i] != None || i > 0 && words[0] == None {
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 9: secondaries get a verdict only after the primary has one (law MatchesReference).

mutants.from: if words[i] != None || i > 0 && words[0] == None {
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 5: a decided series keeps its look's verdict (law MatchesReference).

mutants.name: bn2-run-incomplete-kept
mutants.from:
case (Got, Lost as l):
			words[i] = Some[Verdict]{Value: Refused{Why: l.Why}}
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Verdicts and refusals: a block that lost a counter refuses its series (law MatchesReference).

mutants.name: bn2-stop-on-any-word
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 9: the run goes on for the secondaries after the primary decides (law MatchesReference).

mutants.name: bn2-step-takes-any-block
mutants.rule: the Referee machine rejects a signal for a block it did not ask for (law MachineIsJudge).

mutants.name: bn2-futility-at-80
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 10: the futility stop reads the 50% projection (law MatchesReference).

mutants.name: bn2-futility-never
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 10: a planned series that needs more pairs than its last look is Underpowered (law MatchesReference).

mutants.name: bn2-holm-skipped
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 9: Holm's step-down at 5% over the secondaries (law SecondariesAreOneFamily).

mutants.name: bn2-fixed-unbounded
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 6: a design past MaxPairs is refused before any block (law MatchesReference).

mutants.name: bn2-meter-drops-last
mutants.rule: Meter.ReadsEverySeries: a meter answers every series (law Meter.ReadsEverySeries).

mutants.name: bn2-warm-unmarked
mutants.rule: a warm block is asked for as warm, so a meter can tell it apart (law AlternatesOrder).

mutants.name: bn2-meter-extra-sample
mutants.rule: Meter.ReadsEverySeries: one sample per series, no more (law Meter.ReadsEverySeries).

mutants.name: bn5-refused-value
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Verdicts and refusals: a refused series prints no value (law RefusedHasNoValue).

mutants.name: bn5-digest-skipped
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, The receipt: a block whose digest a hand edit broke is refused (law EditIsRefused).

mutants.name: bn5-update-over-edit
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, The receipt: Update refuses to replace a block a hand edit broke (law EditIsRefused).

mutants.name: bn5-rounds-to-zero
mutants.rule: a nonzero value never prints as zero: its digits follow its interval's width (law NonzeroNeverPrintsZero).

mutants.name: bn5-home-path
mutants.from:
out = out[:at] + "~" + out[end:]
			at = strings.Index(out, prefix)
mutants.to:
out = out[:at] + "~" + out[at+len(prefix):]
			at = strings.Index(out, prefix) + 0*end
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, The receipt: nothing published names a home path (law NoHomePath).

mutants.name: bn5-card-without-block
mutants.rule: a card names the block it comes from (id and digest) (law CardNamesItsBlock).

mutants.name: bn5-update-appends
mutants.rule: Update replaces the block of its id in place (law UpdateReplacesItsBlock).

mutants.name: bn5-proof-dropped
mutants.rule: every value the table prints has its pairs and its interval or exact (law NumberHasItsProof).

mutants.name: bn5-unscrubbed-json
mutants.rule: the receipt JSON names no home path (law NoHomePath).

mutants.name: bn5-schema-unchecked
mutants.rule: Decode refuses a receipt of another schema (law BlockRoundTrips).

mutants.name: copy-membership-fast-path
mutants.rule: The standard library gets no special treatment: a lowering that gives the fast form (a function with no environment) only to std is caught by the copy of a std package.

mutants.name: copy-derived-flag
mutants.rule: The same decision through a flag derived from membership (a package with no unit), which no source scan sees: only the copy property catches it.

mutants.name: copy-name-table
mutants.rule: A new row of a table keyed by a std name changes how the std package lowers and not how its copy does.

mutants.name: copy-normalise-too-much
mutants.from:
if to, ok := final[id.Name]; ok {
				id.Name = to
mutants.rule: The copy property's normaliser folds only how std ships and is named: one that also folds a callee's Go name would pass a privilege, so its self-test plants one difference per kind.
